1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and flange member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler, __wherein the composite fabric is applied as discrete patches rather than continuous layered strips__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric.

2. (Previously presented)

3. (Previously presented)

4. (Original)

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas, __and wherein the adhesive is applied as a wrapped sheet rather than as resin contained within reinforcing fiber bundles__.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, __and wherein the offset is created by intentional placement rather than by wrinkles formed during manufacturing__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base, __wherein the composite fabric is applied as discrete patches on selected areas rather than as continuous layered strips__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes __at least one composite patch on each of the channels and the base, with the patches being positioned to cover the radius areas and extending beyond the radius filler zone__.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, __and wherein the adhesive sheet is applied as a separate structural component rather than as resin contained within the reinforcing fiber bundles__.

14. (Original)

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are __formed from unidirectional composite tape plies arranged in a multi-ply lay-up configuration__.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape including a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a cap and a base, __wherein the cap and base are joined to the flanges using discrete composite fabric patches applied to selected areas rather than continuous layered strips__, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric in the radius areas defining the radius filler zone; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and a layer of structural adhesive applied as a wrapped sheet surrounding the filler to join the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone.
